12. What is electron affinity? Give one important factor which influences the magnitude of

electron affinity. Electron Affinity The amount of energy which is released when an electron is added to an isolated gaseous atom in its ground state in order to change into the negatively charged ion is called electron affinity.
The factor which influences the magnitude of electron affinity is nuclear charge. The value of electron affinity increases with increase in nuclear charge.
